title: validateApp requires owner; pass package.json team in core-shell, billing, reports

summary: validateApp now throws if owner is missing/empty. core-shell (platform), billing (payments), reports (insights) pass their package.json team as owner. Single PR #1 in mono; CI and CD green. Assumptions: owner values hardcoded from each package.json team (build has no JSON import path); platformkit does not call validateApp so was untouched; the packages/ dirs are unrelated.
